communication: Hi Dana, it's Marcus Bell with Lakemont Example Securities LLC (Member FINRA/SIPC). Your quarterly statement is posted in the client portal. Text me if you want to go over it this week.

label.rationale: One retail recipient makes this correspondence under 2210(a)(2). The text is logistics only, makes no claims and names the member firm, so nothing in 2210(d) is triggered.

metadata.subject: The annuity we discussed

communication:
Hi Ruth,

Following up on our call: the Harbor Example Fixed Annuity pays 5.4% a year, locked in for seven years, and your principal is protected by the issuing insurer. It is a simple way to earn more than your bank CD.

Best,
Owen Pratt
Registered Representative, Lakemont Example Securities LLC, Member FINRA/SIPC

violations.excerpt: the Harbor Example Fixed Annuity pays 5.4% a year, locked in for seven years
violations.explanation: A seven-year fixed annuity has surrender charges for early withdrawals and its guarantee depends on the insurer's claims-paying ability; neither is mentioned.

required_actions: Add the surrender-charge schedule and the claims-paying caveat
label.rationale: Correspondence to one retail client. The missing items are features of this specific product (surrender charges, insurer backing), so the finding is a product-specific omission under 2210(d)(1)(A) rather than a general balance problem.

source.notes: same rule, but the omission is product-specific

communication: Quick note from Priya at the Westfield office: the muni ladder we set up is paying as scheduled and the next coupon lands June 1. Call me with any questions. - Priya Raman, Registered Representative

violations.explanation: The message names a branch office and the rep but never the member firm, Westfield Example Brokerage, Inc.

required_actions: Add the member firm name to the signature
label.rationale: Correspondence to three retail clients must prominently disclose the member firm's name under 2210(d)(3); the signature names only the rep and an office.
